Inner Body Meditation (20 Minutes) — Sat Aug 29, 10:45 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled.
(Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Casual Volleyball - North Jersey — Sat Aug 29, 3:00 PM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More We're a group of people who will start by hitting the ball around for the first 20-30 minutes and then will break up into 2-4 teams for two or three hours of play.
If we have more than 20 people show up, we'll break up into three or four teams of 6 (Some may have 7, 8 or 9. Additional players just rotate into play). Games will be to 15 points. Rally scoring. Winner stays on (unless a team has won four straight).
We'll be heading outdoors to the hard court in Leonia off Overpeck County Pk Driveway in the Overpeck County Park.
\*\*\*After playing, we'll be likely heading to Tropical Juice Bar, an idea of regular attendee Kate, for a drink and snack. It's located at 60 River St. in Hackensack. Feel free to join us or suggest another spot for a post-volleyball hangout. \*\*\*
There's no fee to play volleyball and nothing else you need to do besides show up. Come anytime!! All are welcome!!!

item.title: Weekend Warrior Tennis (Sundays) — Sun Aug 30, 9:00 AM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More If you want to meet earlier than 9 AM (like 8 or 8:30) then please let me know by the day before. If you show up later than 9 AM and we have to rotate people in then those who show up by 9 AM will have court priority. It all depends on how many people we have vs. court space on any given day. Keep monitoring the comments for any changes though keep in mind I typically don’t monitor comments after 9 AM.
**RULES:** By signing up you agree to follow these rules:
1\. No instruction or orders are allowed on any of our group courts\. If two or more people are in agreement then they’re welcome to exchange instructions so long as they relinquish their court positions and don’t disrupt active players\. If anyone is instructing or ordering you and you’re not comfortable then please tell them or let me know\. Everyone should feel free to play however they wish without being directed without agreement\, most especially beginners\.

item.description:
Grab our Elul Beach Read – The CorrespondentFor the fifth year in a row, we are excited to recommend our newest “Elul Beach Read,” The Correspondent by Virginia Evans. The book is a 2025 epistolary novel about a 73-year-old retired lawyer, Sybil Van Antwerp, who communicates through letters and emails, and exploring themes of grief, regret, and forgiveness as she confronts a painful past. It’s the perfect opening to explore our own inner work we will do in anticipation of the High Holy Days.Plea
Source: Temple Ner Tamid

item.title: RSC: Insight into Rehearsal — Thu Sep 17, 6:00 PM
item.description:
What is it like to step into the rehearsal room of a Royal Shakespeare Company production? This lecture and demonstration offers a look into the process behind one of the world’s foremost Shakespearian interpreters. All are welcome for this chance to see three amazing artists demonstrate the methodology of how RSC artists approach the exploration, analysis, and staging of a scene. The featured artists are Aaron Parsons, Joseph Arkley, and Eloise Secker.
Source: PEAK Performances at MSU
